name: phase1-idp-portal
description: Build Phase 1 of a real self-service IDP portal: EKS Terraform + provision/destroy scripts + cluster registry + FastAPI backend + Vite/React portal. Real infra, cost-safe, no mocks.

steps.prompt:
Investigate and write an ordered implementation plan for Phase 1 of a self-service internal developer platform (IDP) portal. Write the plan to c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\plan.md (create the directory if needed).

The deliverable lives in a NEW folder: {{target_dir}} (c:\Devops\Repository\Developer-friendly-infra). Windows + Git Bash. Use absolute paths.

FIRST read these existing repos fully to match conventions (they are readable):
1. EKS/VPC Terraform: c:\Devops\Repository\terraform-aws-eks\terraform-aws-eks-main\00-vpc and \40-eks and \10-sg - read variables.tf/main.tf/outputs.tf/provider.tf/locals.tf/data.tf.
2. ArgoCD install flow: c:\Devops\Repository\eks-cluster-argocd\eks-cluster-argocd\argocd.sh plus app-of-apps.yaml, applications/, namespaces/.
3. Python tools to reuse: c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-crewAi\app\tools\ - k8s_tools.py, eks_tools.py, health_tools.py, incident_tools.py, deploy_tools.py.

Fixed facts: AWS account 589389425618, region us-east-1, Terraform latest, kubectl latest.

Phase 1 scope to plan (foundation only):
- terraform/: small cheap REAL EKS (VPC 2 AZs, single NAT, EKS subnet tags, one managed node group t3.medium desired2/min2/max3), S3 remote state with use_lockfile=true (bucket/key as documented placeholders), outputs cluster_name/endpoint/region/oidc_provider_arn, everything tagged Project=developer-friendly-infra. Prefer official terraform-aws-modules vpc+eks pinned UNLESS reused modules use raw resources - match reused style; document the choice.
- scripts/provision.sh and destroy.sh: paired cost-safe commands (set -euo pipefail). provision: terraform init+apply, aws eks update-kubeconfig, install ArgoCD via argocd.sh flow, wait for argocd ready, write cluster entry to registry/clusters.json, echo cost warning + exact destroy command + argocd admin password retrieval. destroy: terraform destroy, remove registry entry, confirm first.
- registry/clusters.json: source of truth the portal reads (name, region, environment, cluster_endpoint, argocd_url, created_at, status). Helper to add/remove entries safely (python or jq).
- backend/ FastAPI: GET /api/clusters, GET /api/namespaces?cluster=, GET /api/pods?cluster=&namespace= (name/ready/status/restarts/start_time/last-state reason so OOMKilled shows; reuse k8s_tools.py), GET /api/argocd/apps?cluster= (real ArgoCD REST API, token via env var, graceful 'not configured' NOT fake data), GET /api/health. Guard CrewAI imports in try/except (project needs py 3.10-3.13, portal must start without CrewAI). requirements.txt. backend/README.md.
- frontend/ Vite+React dark-themed portal: cluster list with environment + created-at + 'running since' cost indicator; on select -> namespace dropdown + live pod table with status pill badges (green Running, yellow Pending, red CrashLoopBackOff/Error) + Refresh; ArgoCD panel with Synced/OutOfSync + Healthy/Degraded badges; empty states not fabricated rows; vite proxy /api to backend; frontend/README.md.
- top-level README.md (ascii architecture: provision -> EKS+ArgoCD -> registry -> portal; Phase 1 scope; Phases 2-4 preview) and RUNBOOK.md (exact ordered commands the USER runs in their own terminal, since the orchestrator shell is down: set S3 backend bucket, ./scripts/provision.sh dev-eu staging, start backend, start frontend, open portal, ./scripts/destroy.sh dev-eu; plus verification commands aws sts get-caller-identity / terraform version / kubectl version --client; plus argocd admin password+token retrieval).

HARD CONSTRAINTS the plan must enforce: REAL infra only, NO mock/fake data anywhere (graceful empty states OK). Cost safety is first-class (paired provision/destroy, small node group, single NAT, tagged, reliable teardown). NO auto/agent-driven write actions; deploy (Phase 3) is OUT of scope but structure backend so an explicit confirm-gated deploy endpoint is a clean future add. The build agent and reviewer must NEVER run terraform apply / aws eks / kubectl apply or anything that creates cloud resources or costs money - only read-only validation (terraform validate, terraform fmt -check, python -m py_compile, npm run build). The user runs all live commands.

Also: {{target_dir}} is a brand-new empty folder with no git history. The plan's first implementation action is `git init` there, then do work on branch phase1-idp (a worktree is optional for a brand-new empty repo - direct branch work is acceptable; note the choice).

Implement Phase 1 of the IDP portal in {{target_dir}} (c:\Devops\Repository\Developer-friendly-infra) following the plan at c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\plan.md.

On the FIRST iteration: implement the whole plan. On LATER iterations: read the reviewer's findings at c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\review.md and fix every issue raised.

Key reused sources to read: c:\Devops\Repository\terraform-aws-eks\terraform-aws-eks-main\{00-vpc,10-sg,40-eks}; c:\Devops\Repository\eks-cluster-argocd\eks-cluster-argocd\argocd.sh; c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-crewAi\app\tools\{k8s_tools,eks_tools,health_tools,incident_tools,deploy_tools}.py. Fixed facts: account 589389425618, region us-east-1.

What to deliver (full detail is in plan.md): terraform/ (cheap real EKS: VPC 2AZ single NAT, subnet tags, node group t3.medium x2 max3, S3 remote state use_lockfile=true with placeholder bucket/key, outputs, Project tag); scripts/provision.sh + destroy.sh (paired, set -euo pipefail, cost-safe, registry write/remove, argocd install via argocd.sh flow); registry/clusters.json (+safe add/remove helper); backend/ FastAPI (endpoints /api/clusters, /api/namespaces, /api/pods, /api/argocd/apps, /api/health; reuse k8s_tools.py; guard CrewAI import in try/except; requirements.txt; README); frontend/ Vite+React dark portal (cluster list + running-since, namespace dropdown, live pod table with status pill badges + refresh, ArgoCD sync/health panel, empty states, vite proxy, README); top-level README.md + RUNBOOK.md.

ABSOLUTE RULES: (1) {{target_dir}} starts empty with no git - run `git init` there first, work on branch phase1-idp. (2) REAL infra only, NO mock/fake data - graceful empty states only. (3) Cost safety first-class: paired provision/destroy, small node group, single NAT, tagged, reliable teardown. (4) NO auto/agent-driven writes; no deploy endpoint yet but keep backend structured for a future explicit confirm-gated one. (5) You MUST NOT run terraform apply / aws eks / kubectl apply or ANY command that creates cloud resources or costs money - the user runs those. (6) Run ONLY read-only validation if your shell works: `terraform validate` and `terraform fmt -check` in terraform/, `python -m py_compile` on backend .py files, `npm install && npm run build` in frontend/. Record exactly what you ran and the results in c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\verification.md (create it). If your shell CANNOT run commands, write that plainly in verification.md and list what remains unverified - do NOT claim success you did not verify, and do NOT fabricate validation output.

Commit your work on the phase1-idp branch when done (git add + commit in {{target_dir}}).

Review the Phase 1 IDP portal implementation in {{target_dir}} (c:\Devops\Repository\Developer-friendly-infra) against the plan at c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\plan.md and the hard constraints.

Do NOT re-run build/test suites - read c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\verification.md for what the coder validated. You MUST NOT run terraform apply / aws eks / kubectl apply or anything that creates cloud resources.

Gate on these, any failure = REVISE:
1. REAL infra only - NO mock/fake data anywhere in backend or frontend (graceful empty states are OK; fabricated pods/apps/clusters are NOT). Grep for hardcoded fake pod/app lists.
2. NO auto/agent-driven write actions anywhere; no deploy endpoint that executes without explicit user action. deploy_tools.py's auto rollback/restart must NOT be wired into any endpoint.
3. Cost safety: node group is small (t3.medium, max 3), single NAT, everything tagged, and destroy.sh reliably tears down terraform AND removes the registry entry. provision.sh echoes a cost warning + the destroy command.
4. All five backend endpoints exist and are shaped right (/api/clusters from registry, /api/namespaces, /api/pods with restarts + last-state reason, /api/argocd/apps hitting the real ArgoCD API with graceful 'not configured', /api/health). CrewAI import is guarded so the API starts without it.
5. Frontend has: cluster list with running-since, namespace dropdown, live pod table with colored status badges + refresh, ArgoCD sync/health panel, empty states.
6. terraform/ uses S3 remote state with use_lockfile=true and has the required outputs; EKS subnet tags present.
7. README.md + RUNBOOK.md exist; RUNBOOK lists the exact user-run commands (provision/destroy/verification/argocd password).

Write your findings to c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\review.md. Then write the machine-readable verdict to c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\review.json as {"verdict":"APPROVED"} if all gates pass, otherwise {"verdict":"REVISE"}. Always finish by calling send_message with severity success and a one-line summary of the verdict and top issues.

Finalize Phase 1 of the IDP portal in {{target_dir}} (c:\Devops\Repository\Developer-friendly-infra).

1. Ensure all work is committed on the phase1-idp branch (git add -A && git commit if anything is uncommitted).
2. Since this is a brand-new standalone repo, make phase1-idp the primary branch: if a 'main' or 'mainline' branch exists, fast-forward merge phase1-idp into it; otherwise leave phase1-idp as the current committed branch and note that.
3. Read c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\verification.md and review.md, and produce a final summary listing: what was built, what read-only validation passed, and CRITICALLY everything that remains UNVERIFIED and must be run by the user in their own terminal (terraform validate/apply, provision.sh against real AWS, kubectl, npm build if not run, the live portal). Do not claim the cluster was created or the portal was run - it was not. Write this summary to c:\Devops\Repository\devops-microservices-platform\.agents\tasks\phase1-idp\SUMMARY.md and also send it via send_message severity success.
